headline: Three newcomers wander in near the bottom while DeepSeek keeps its grip on the top
summary: deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-20261017 still holds No. 1 with 29.0% of tokens, and three fresh faces landed between ranks 42 and 46. Meanwhile, minimax/minimax-m3.1-flash-20261019 took a 12-place tumble in a single day, the biggest one-day drop on the board.
highlights: DeepSeek is still the provider to beat at 39.7% of tokens, and its top model refuses to be knocked off the podium.
Tencent's tencent/hy4-20261104 is up 3 places over seven days to No. 2 with 8.2% of tokens.
Xiaomi's xiaomi/mimo-v2.6-flash-20260921 climbed 14 spots over the past week to No. 10.
DeepSeek, Zhipu AI and Tencent together hold 59.6% of tokens.
Dropouts: meta/muse-ember-20261109 (last at No. 45), google/gemma-4-31b-it-20260402 (last at No. 48), and openai/gpt-oss-120b (last at No. 49).
